_comment: Maps the [TAG] of policy.md §2 docstring citations to the reference documents under this directory (stems of <name>.md). Maintained by scripts/reference_coverage.py (--register, --rebuild-registry) and by scripts/dataset_pipeline.py --source TAG=path.

AB09.title: S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*, Cambridge University Press, 2009.

AP14.title: J. Alperin-Sheriff, C. Peikert, Faster Bootstrapping with Polynomial Error, CRYPTO 2014; ePrint 2014/094, version dated 13 June 2014.

BB04.title: D. Boneh, X. Boyen, Efficient Selective-ID Secure Identity Based Encryption Without Random Oracles, Cryptology ePrint Archive 2004/172, full version dated December 2004.

BV11.title: Z. Brakerski, V. Vaikuntanathan, Efficient Fully Homomorphic Encryption from (Standard) LWE, FOCS 2011; full version (39 pages).

BV14.title: Z. Brakerski, V. Vaikuntanathan, Lattice-Based FHE as Secure as PKE, ITCS 2014; ePrint 2013/541.

Bar89.title: D. A. Mix Barrington, Bounded-Width Polynomial-Size Branching Programs Recognize Exactly Those Languages in NC¹, J. Comput. Syst. Sci. 38(1):150–164, 1989.

GRS25.title: V. Guruswami, A. Rudra, M. Sudan, *Essential Coding Theory*, draft textbook, 2025/26.

PW10.title: C. Peikert and B. Waters, Lossy Trapdoor Functions and Their Applications, author version dated 4 June 2010.

Pei16.title: C. Peikert, A Decade of Lattice Cryptography, author version dated 17 February 2016.

RY20.title: A. Rao, A. Yehudayoff, *Communication Complexity and Applications*, Cambridge University Press, 2020.

Rou16.title: T. Roughgarden, *Communication Complexity (for Algorithm Designers)*, Foundations and Trends in Theoretical Computer Science 11(3–4), 2016.

Wu24.title: D. Wu, CS395T Topics in Cryptography, Spring 2024 lecture notes, compilation last updated 30 April 2024.
